question: Can finite A/B compensation be made destructive at a half-applied release under both the public-base and clean-target references,while keeping the full standalone response?
construction_access: Frozen MNIST expert/publicbase/fixedhead/original800synthetic views and16384layer vectors only. The clean target is available only to construction;this is not an attacker granted the original checkpoint. No partner,natural test,exposed witnesses,old protected B,or selected directions.
fixed: Same original rank32 A construction,original native quadratic/rho/tau,RN initialization,500 steps,Armijo and stopping. Same clean source inputs,no new image generation. Only add the clean target as a second reference;coefficient .5 is the fixed main merger coefficient,not a sweep.

references.distinction: Scaling sensitivity and loss barriers are known. This is a data-free post-hoc A/B solver extension,not Trap2 official reproduction or novel optimizer.

mechanism: For F(t)=(B+t*dB)phi(u+t*v)+b+t*db, with u=Ax+a,v=dA*x: F(l)-(1-l)F(0)-lF(1)=B[phi(u+l*v)-(1-l)phi(u)-lphi(u+v)]+l*dB[phi(u+l*v)-phi(u+v)]. Hence F(l)-F(0)=l*(F(1)-F(0))+C_l. Linear-activation special case C_l=-l(1-l)*dB*dA*x. Evaluate full QuickGELU/LN/readout at l=.5;nonzero hidden changes alone are insufficient.
objective: Same calibration-aware logmean true-class probabilities over raw/corrected logits,in four clean construction contexts: target/base direct and AGA-target;target/clean-target direct and AGA-target. Priors computed separately from the same800source views. Do not fit priors or model directions using natural/partner data.
source_feasibility: One last iterate only: native teacher agreement >= RN;raw and calibrated teacher-correct counts strictly lower than RN in all four contexts;FP32 native quadratic<=same tau+tolerance. Any failure closes this point before natural evaluation;no coefficient/layer/source/rank/step adjustment. A source pass permits full evaluation,not a defense claim.
cache: Task-direct reuses native prefix;task-recovered captures clean merge(originalAGA,target,.5) on the same800images. No partner input. Full-tail identity and a directional derivative checked before optimization.

budget.native_ellipsoid: Unchanged from previous fixed A construction
budget.norm_budget: Report logical D and each matrix relative norm;historical .5 not silently relaxed/relabelled.

evaluation: If source feasible,freeze point before natural inputs;fullMNIST native,then fixedTA.5/SVHN and authorAGA target/both plus same64noisecalibration,matched originals reused. Native losses reported without source repair. No other task or hyperparameter search in this batch.
scope: The two references do not cover arbitrary unknown partners. Previous LN/P,OB self-chord failures stay closed;this acts on current numerical A/B compensation and exact classification. No claim of SVD contribution or complete teacher-intended method before results.
